about_the_game:
1001 TVs - Screen Mirroring from phone to PC

1001 TVs(PC):Mirror your phone/tablet screen to your computer, also can mirror your computer screen to TV.

We are a professional team on screen mirroring, always focus on the core features:

* Screen mirroring from Phone to PC:

- Support mirroring from multiple phones/tablets to the same PC simultaneously, with one-click automatic window arrangement.

- Freely zoom the phone mirroring window, supports full screen, force screen rotation, hide title bar, and more.

- Auto rotation adaptation, Perfectly maintains the original aspect ratio of your phone.

- Pause mirroring, and resume anytime – all controlled from your computer.

* Screen mirroring from PC to TV:

- Mirror screen to multiple TVs at the same time.

- Supports mirroring the Primary Screen, Extended Screen, or Virtual Screen.

- High frame rate support for smoother visuals.

- Mirror screen to PC, Mac, Phone, Pad and so on.

* German-quality you can trust:

- Real-time, Low-Latency Screen Mirroring: Excellent balance between image quality and smoothness, with audio-video sync and no lag.

- Stable Long-Duration Connections: Meets industrial-grade mirroring requirements.

- HD Quality: Achieve high-definition picture quality through flexible configuration.

- Privacy & Security: All screen data is transmitted only within your local network, never uploaded to the internet, guaranteeing 100% privacy and security.

* Additonal Features:

- Annotation Tool: Draw and annotate directly on the mirrored screen.

- File Transfer: Easily transfer files between your computer and phone.

* Getting Started is Easy:

1. Install "1001 TVs" application on phone and receiving device (PC/TV/Tablet).

2. Ensure all devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

3. Open the app, select the target device, and start screen mirroring immediately.

* Pricing:

- Screen mirroring from Phone to PC: Offers a free trial, A paid membership is required to continue using after the trial.

- Screen mirroring from PC to TV: Basic features are free, some advanced features require payment.

* Contact Us:

- Email: 1001tvs@nero.com

- Website:

- YouTube: nero1001TVs
